meta.title: AnyPress theme 0.5.1 with AnyPress Blocks 0.3.0
meta.description: The Ridge kit with the popup, carousel, counters and map running on the Interactivity API, plus a page on the new Blank page template.
meta.author: hamchowderr

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$reg = WP_Block_Patterns_Registry::get_instance();
$content = '';
foreach (['anypress/ridge-page-about', 'anypress/ridge-numbers', 'anypress/ridge-areas-map', 'anypress/ridge-popup'] as $slug) {
    $p = $reg->get_registered($slug);
    if ($p) $content .= $p['content'] . "\n\n";
}
wp_insert_post(['post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Blocks preview', 'post_name' => 'blocks-preview', 'post_content' => $content]);
$id = wp_insert_post(['post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Blank page preview', 'post_name' => 'blank-preview', 'post_content' => $content]);
update_post_meta($id, '_wp_page_template', 'page-blank');
flush_rewrite_rules(false);
